# Techfami: full guide for AI assistants and agents

> Techfami (also written TechFami) is a technology company from India that designs and builds websites, mobile apps (Android and iOS), AI chatbots, generative AI solutions, custom AI development, UI/UX design and SaaS products. It also maintains software that clients already have and adds new features to it, and it builds and runs its own cloud ERP, Techfami ERP. Tagline: "Your Ideas. Our Tech." Website: https://www.techfami.com/

This file is a plain-text summary of the public website. Prices and details are starting points; each project gets a clear quote before work begins. Last updated: 2026-11-23.

## Quick facts
- Company: Techfami

## The promise: free demo first
- You tell us your idea. Our team understands it and creates a demo of it at no charge.
- You do not pay first. We continue only after you confirm the demo.
- If you do not like the demo, nothing happens and you owe nothing for it.

## How it works
1. Tell us: share your idea and goals in your own words. A message or a short call is enough.
2. See your demo: our team creates a demo to show you, at no charge.
3. You confirm: if you like it we move ahead with a clear quote. If you are not sure, there is no pressure.
4. Build, launch and support: we build it, launch it and support it after it goes live.

## Pricing (starting prices)
Prices are shown in INR for India and USD elsewhere. Clear quote before any build.

| Plan | Price | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| Starter | INR 19,999 (about USD 250) | One-page modern website for individuals and small businesses |
| Pro Business | INR 39,999 (USD 450) | Choose one: a 5-page dynamic website with admin panel, or a native Android and iOS app |
| Enterprise | from INR 49,999 (from USD 700) | A complete multi-platform business ecosystem |

- Starter includes: one-page modern website, WhatsApp chat integration, responsive mobile design, SEO-ready structure, delivery in 15 days, email contact form, basic analytics setup, Google Maps showcase, 12 months free custom domain, 12 months free support.
- Pro Business, website option: 5-page dynamic website with admin panel, server backend and database integration, on-page SEO optimisation, social media integration, custom contact and newsletter forms.
- Pro Business, app option: native Android and iOS app, API and database connectivity, push notifications and advanced chatbot, Google Play Store deployment, 12 months free support and maintenance.
- Enterprise includes: Android and iOS apps for customers, Android and iOS apps for sellers and delivery staff, a responsive business website, a full-featured scalable admin dashboard, multi-user access control, secure payments and order management, real-time chat and AI bot integration, ongoing maintenance and upgrades.

## Product: Techfami ERP
Page: https://www.techfami.com/products.html — Live product: https://erp.techfami.com (free sign-up at https://erp.techfami.com/signup)

A cloud-based ERP for garment, textile, manufacturing, trading and other growing businesses. It runs in a web browser on desktop, tablet or mobile, with no installation. Built in India.

Who it is for: manufacturers; garment and textile businesses; traders and distributors.

Modules and features:
- GST billing and invoices: GST-compliant invoices and bills, custom product fields (for example MRP, colour, size, fabric type), PDF export, financial-year-wise records
- Delivery challans and LR: challans with LR number, transport details and delivery location, status tracking (pending, delivered, returned), PDF documents and Excel reports
- Inventory and stock: raw materials and finished products, stock movements, opening balances, categories, colours, search and filters, Excel stock reports
- Sales and purchase management: customers, suppliers, transactions and records
- Production management and process tracking: production orders, multiple processes such as knitting, dyeing, cutting, stitching and finishing, process-wise quantities and progress
- Sampling management: sample tracking from creation to completion
- Employee and production payments: payments based on completed quantities or processes
- Advance payments and outstanding tracking: payment modes, status (pending, fully adjusted, extra), advance receipt PDFs, outstanding balances
- Product management with dynamic fields and columns instead of a rigid data structure
- Analytics dashboard and reports: sales trends, product performance, date-range filtering, Excel export
- Multi-user role-based access: control who can view, create, edit or delete each module

## Frequently asked questions
**Do I really not pay anything first?** Correct. You tell us your idea, our team creates a demo for you to see. The demo is free. We only continue after you confirm.

**What if I do not like the demo?** Then nothing happens. You owe nothing for the demo and there is no bill.

**What can you build?** Websites, mobile apps for Android and iOS, AI chatbots and generative AI features, custom AI development, UI/UX design and SaaS products. We also maintain software you already have and add features to it. And we build and run our own product, Techfami ERP.

**How much does it cost?** Starter website plan from INR 19,999 (about USD 250). Pro Business INR 39,999 (USD 450) for a dynamic website or a mobile app. Enterprise from INR 49,999 (USD 700). A clear quote is given before we build.

**How long does a project take?** A Starter one-page website is delivered in 15 days. Larger projects depend on the scope; the timeline comes with the quote.

**Do you support the project after launch?** Yes. The Starter plan and the Pro Business app option include 12 months of free support. Enterprise includes ongoing maintenance and upgrades.

**What is Techfami ERP?** A cloud ERP for garment, textile, manufacturing and trading businesses covering GST billing, challans, stock, production and payments.

**How do I get started?** Type your idea in the box on the home page, or message on WhatsApp at +91 9930870979. Replies usually come within one working day.
